mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_media WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='active' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_media SET status='replaced', replaced_at=#{at}, next_cleanup_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='active'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_media WHERE status='replaced' AND (next_cleanup_at IS NULL OR next_cleanup_at <= NOW(3)) ORDER BY next_cleanup_at ASC, replaced_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_media SET status='purged', next_cleanup_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='replaced'
UPDATE agent_media SET next_cleanup_at=DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 1 HOUR) WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='replaced'
